toolsPreview.name: get_company_info
toolsPreview.description: Basic facts about STORE INVENT & PARTNERS, s.r.o.: history, scale, coverage, technology, contacts.

toolsPreview.name: list_services
toolsPreview.description: List of all 6 inventory services with short descriptions and detail page URLs.

toolsPreview.name: get_service_details
toolsPreview.description: Details of one service: what it includes, how it works, practical notes.

toolsPreview.name: get_quote_requirements
toolsPreview.description: What information the sales team needs to prepare a quote (pricing is always individual), plus data-format details and inventory preparation advice. Call this before submit_inquiry.

toolsPreview.name: get_faq
toolsPreview.description: Frequently asked questions and answers about the services.

toolsPreview.name: submit_inquiry
toolsPreview.description: Submit a real non-binding inquiry (nezávazná poptávka) to the sales team. They reply to the given e-mail, usually within 24 hours on business days. Collect the details from get_quote_requirements first and include them in the message.

toolsPreview.name: ask_question
toolsPreview.description: Ask a free-form question about the company or its inventory services; answered from the company knowledge base (Czech or English).
